resources.string: Anything you serve through the reverse proxy becomes reachable by anyone on the same network (or the internet, if you port-forward). Do not expose sensitive files. Continue?

Hosting creates a public https://*.trycloudflare.com link: anyone on the internet with the link can open this site, and traffic passes through Cloudflare. The address is random and changes on every Host. Do not expose sensitive files. Continue?
